intents.response: Hello! I am the AI assistant for ABC Engineering College. How can I help you?
ABC Engineering College is a leading institute located in Nagpur offering engineering and management education.
ABC Engineering College is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra.
The college offers B.Tech, BCA, BBA, MBA and M.Tech programs.
Departments include Computer Science, Mechanical, Civil, Electrical and Electronics Engineering.
Admissions are done through entrance exams and online application on the college website.
Students must complete 12th with science stream for engineering courses.
The yearly fees range from ₹60,000 to ₹1,20,000 depending on the course.
The college provides separate hostel facilities for boys and girls with WiFi and security.
The college has a large digital library with thousands of books and journals.
Top companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro and Capgemini visit the campus for placements.
The average placement rate of the college is around 85%.
The campus has a large cafeteria providing healthy and affordable food.
Sports facilities include cricket ground, football field, basketball court and indoor games.
The college provides bus transport from major areas of the city.
You can contact the college at +91 9876543210 or email admission@abccollege.edu.
